svg.aria-label: Eureka demo. In a web page, a sentence is selected, Option+T is pressed, one line is typed and Enter saves it: the thought appears in Obsidian as a colored card with the page as its source. Then the same thing happens in a code editor, and a second card lands in the same note.

g.text: Courier routes drawn live = a city’s bloodstream
